## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes
- [ ] If a tool was added or changed: `TOOL_NAMES` updated, `response_format` accepted, and the
      README tool table updated including its plan tier
- [ ] If a renderer was added or changed: it returns `undefined` for unrecognised payloads rather
      than rendering partially
- [ ] No API key, real target hostname, or customer data in the diff or test fixtures
